name: Agami Village
source:
You are a fisherman visiting a strange village in search of better fish. Once you start fishing in the village lakes, something doesn't seem to want you to leave. Talk to villagers and cast your line to learn more about the village and discover the secrets hidden within.

[From [url=https://staradavid.itch.io/agami-village]Itch.io[/url]]
